children: Emirates Islamic is offering eligible new-to-bank customers a waiver of relationship fees for a period of six months when they open an account under selected Business Banking packages.
Running until December 31, 2026, the campaign is designed to give UAE businesses a stronger start as they establish a new banking relationship.
The relationship fee waiver applies to specific Business Banking packages including Business Premium, Emarati Absher Business Account and Businesswomen Account.

New customers of the packages may also be eligible to participate in Emirates Islamic’s ongoing Business Banking Mega Campaign, which offers opportunities to win prizes from a total pool of AED1.5 million ($410,000), subject to eligibility criteria and applicable terms and conditions.

Mohamed Al Hadi, Head of Retail Banking and Wealth Management at Emirates Islamic, said: “Choosing a trusted banking partner is an important decision for any business. Through this campaign, eligible new-to-bank customers can benefit from a six-month waiver of the relationship fee, offering immediate value as they begin their journey with Emirates Islamic. We remain committed to delivering banking solutions that meet the needs of entrepreneurs and businesses across the UAE.”

Ghazanfar Naqvi, Head of Business Banking at Emirates Islamic, said: “Businesses value banking propositions that are simple, relevant and designed around their evolving needs. By waiving the relationship fee for the first six months across selected packages, we are reducing the initial cost of banking for eligible new customers while giving them access to solutions designed for their business journey. This includes dedicated propositions for Emirati Entrepreneurs and women in business, two important communities within the UAE’s growing entrepreneurial ecosystem.”—TradeArabia News Service
